parole.significato: log, timber (heavy wooden beam used or carved ready for use in construction of a log house or similar)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *hirci (compare Ingrian hersi, Karelian hirsi, Estonian hirs, Votic irsi), borrowed from Proto-Slavic *žьrdь (compare Russian жердь (žerdʹ)).

parole.significato: dog, hound; especially a large one
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *hurtta, borrowed from Slavic, ultimately from Proto-Slavic *xъrtъ.

parole.significato: yoke (bar or frame by which two draught animals are joined at their necks)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *iges, borrowed from Proto-Slavic *jьgo (gen. *jьga, *jьžese; compare Old East Slavic иго (igo), gen. ига (iga), *ижесе (*ižese)), from earlier *jъgo (gen. *jъga, *jъgese), from Proto-Balto-Slavic *juga-, from Proto-Indo-European *yugóm.

From Proto-Finnic *kimalainën. Possibly a borrowing from Proto-Slavic *čьmeľь, itself likely onomatopoetic; attempts at deriving from kimeä (“shrill”) or kimaltaa (“to glitter”) are semantically unconvincing, since bumblebees don't glitter and the sound they emit is the opposite of shrill. parole.significato: to work (shape, form, or improve a material)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *mook'at'ak, likely borrowed from late Proto-Slavic *mǫka (“torment, torture”) (compare Russian му́ка (múka)), and modified with + -ta.

parole.significato: to shovel, scoop, draw; to lift (and throw) with a scoop, ladle, shovel, spoon, etc.
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *mättädäk, possibly borrowed from Proto-Slavic *metati or older Proto-Balto-Slavic *met-.

parole.significato: pay, salary, wage (money given in return for work; salary or wages)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *palkka (compare Estonian palk, Livonian pālka, Livvi palku, Votic palkkõ), possibly borrowed from Proto-Slavic *bȏlgo (compare Russian бо́лого (bólogo), Czech blaho).
From Proto-Finnic *palttina, borrowed from Proto-Slavic *poltьno (whence Old East Slavic полотьно (polotĭno)).
From Proto-Finnic *cirppi (compare Estonian sirp, North Karelian čirppi), borrowed from Proto-Slavic *sьrpъ (compare Russian серп (serp)).

parole.significato: A traditional Russian (толокно (tolokno)) / Finnish / Estonian (kama) finely milled flour mixture made of roasted barle…
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *talkkuna, borrowed from Proto-Slavic *tolkъno (*talkuna) (whence Old East Slavic толокъно (tolokŭno) (with pleophony)).

From Proto-Finnic *taltta, borrowed from Proto-Slavic *dolto (*dalta) (whence Old East Slavic долото (doloto) (with pleophony)). Cognates include Karelian tauttu, Ludian talt, Veps taut. First mentioned in a Finnish dictionary in 1787.
From Proto-Finnic *vapada, probably borrowed from early Proto-Slavic *svabadā (later *svoboda (“freedom”)).
